name: Salisbury Steak & Mushroom Gravy with Asparagus

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.341 kg white mushrooms
3 small bunches asparagus
1 ½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Slice the mushrooms and transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel and small dice the onion; add to the bowl of mushrooms.
Fill a medium saucepan (one that is big enough to fit the asparagus) about halfway with water; cover and bring to a boil.
In a medium bowl, combine and mix together the minced garlic, ground beef, onion powder, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper. Shape the beef mixture into six oval patties.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg lean ground beef
1 ½ tsp onion powder
1 ½ tsp Worcestershire sauce
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Cut (or snap off) and discard the woody ends of the asparagus; leaves the spears on the cutting board.
Add butter to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the beef patties in the skillet and cook until they are browned and the meat is nearly cooked through, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.

Once the water is boiling, add the asparagus. Cook until the asparagus is tender and bright green, 3 to 4 minutes. Drain in a colander and rinse under cold water to stop the cooking process; set aside to drain.
Once the patties have been transferred, add more butter to the skillet.
Add the onion and mushrooms and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until the onions and mushrooms are softened and lightly browned, 3 to 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Sprinkle flour over the mushrooms and onions and stir until fully incorporated. Then pour in the broth, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the skillet.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp all-purpose flour
355 ml (1 ½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Return the beef patties and any juices to the skillet. Simmer until the patties are cooked through, 2 to 3 minutes.
Shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Stir almost everything into the gravy (save some for garnishing).
Divide the asparagus between plates and place the steak and gravy over top. Enjoy!
